name: To Love-Ru Diary~ - Sister
original_name: とらぶるだいあり～・しすたぁ
source:
An immoral story of flirty-dirty between a student and his younger sister.

A service-minded sister Mikan is always steady taking care of her oniichan.
But in heart, she wants his affection since her age is as such.

When they take bath together for the first time in a while, they start getting
into an immoral relationship. But he happens to see that she plays with her male classmate.
Does she have a boyfriend? What will happen to their immoral love...?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ239141.html/?locale=en_US]Dlsite English[/url]]
translation:
这是一段发生在男学生与亲妹妹之间、甜腻而又背德的禁忌物语。

极具奉献精神的妹妹美柑，平日里总是无微不至地照料着哥哥的起居。
然而正值情窦初开的年纪，她的内心深处其实一直渴望得到哥哥的疼爱。

当兄妹俩时隔多日再次一起泡澡时，两人终于跨过了界限，坠入了背德的肉体关系。可没过多久，哥哥却无意间撞见她和班上的男同学打得火热。
难道妹妹已经有男朋友了吗？兄妹俩这段背德的恋情究竟将何去何从……？

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ239141.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英文版[/url]]
